The products we supply are used and applied in the following sectors: industry, agriculture, railway, road transport, aviation, oil and gas production, energy, food production and processing. Our specialists are professionally versed in the problems of equipment operation and product characteristics, offering each client a unique and optimal technical solution at the best competitive prices, taking into account the value of the products and personal delivery conditions. Today, with the help of the products supplied by us, complex problems are solved in the field of metallurgy, energy, food industry, petrochemical, mechanical engineering, and in many other sectors. We also represent the entire range of products from CRC, one of the largest manufacturers of MRO chemicals in the world. The right approach to the selection of processes and lubricants reduces maintenance costs, extends the life of the equipment, and simplifies its operation. 
![](https://coral-bic.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/work-safety-protection-equipment.jpg)
Thanks to direct deliveries from manufacturers, we provide the most favorable cost, uninterrupted supply, and guarantee of quality and originality of products. Our experience and professional materials will help to improve technological processes and solve the most complex problems. In addition to a full range of high-performance lubricants, compounds, pastes, oils and fluids, dispersions, and anti-friction coatings, you can count on us to jointly solve production problems and provide extensive technical support.  
We thank those who have already made a choice in favor of our company and are happy to offer cooperation to new customers!

Striving to meet the increasing and diversified demands of our customers.

Becoming a professional marketing partner for our principal suppliers to meet the objectives of sales, market information, and customer service.
